skill.name: completion-integrity
skill.description: Prevents shortcut fixes by blocking commits with warning suppressions, commented tests, deleted assertions, and related integrity violations.
skill.summary: Adds completion integrity checks for commits and manual verification workflows.
skill.author: ANcpLua

security_audit.summary: Two static findings are confirmed because SKILL.md tells users to execute plugin shell scripts for installation and manual checks. The other two findings are markdown or inline prose false positives, and I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or deceptive intent in the skill text.

remediation.issue: Install instructions execute a shell script from the plugin root.
remediation.suggestion: Document the script effects, required permissions, and expected Git hook changes. Require explicit user confirmation before running it.

remediation.issue: Manual verification instructions execute a shell script from the plugin root.
remediation.suggestion: State that the command runs local plugin code and should be used only after the plugin source is trusted.

content.value_statement: Shortcut fixes can hide failures, delete tests, or suppress warnings. This skill adds completion integrity checks that flag risky commit patterns before review.
actual_capabilities: Installs a Git pre-commit hook through the documented setup command.
Runs a manual integrity check through the documented verification command.
Flags warning suppressions, commented tests, deleted assertions, test deletion, empty catch blocks, and fresh TODOs.
Guides users to explain legitimate suppressions in commit messages.
Encourages real verification before claiming a task is complete.
limitations: Requires shell access to run the documented install and manual check commands.
May flag legitimate warning suppressions that need human review.
Does not prove code correctness or complete test coverage.
Requires a Git workflow and hook installation to block commits automatically.

use_cases.title: Prevent Shortcut Fixes
use_cases.description: Catch staged changes that remove tests, delete assertions, or suppress warnings before they reach review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Commit Quality
use_cases.description: Add a local integrity gate that reinforces team rules for tests, assertions, warnings, and TODOs.

use_cases.title: Audit AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Require verification checks before an AI assistant claims completion or prepares a commit.

prompt_templates.title: Install Integrity Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up the completion integrity hook for this repository. Explain what it will check before running any shell command.

prompt_templates.title: Run Manual Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the completion integrity manual check on my current changes. Summarize any blocked patterns and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Blocked Commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the integrity check failure. Identify whether each warning suppression, deleted assertion, or test change is justified.

prompt_templates.title: Harden an AI Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced policy design for AI-assisted development.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use completion integrity as a release gate for AI-generated changes. Define verification steps before final response and before commit.

output_examples.input: Check my staged changes before commit.
output_examples.output: The review reports one warning suppression and one commented test. It recommends fixing the root causes before committing.

output_examples.input: I need to keep one suppression for a platform-specific warning.
output_examples.output: The result asks for a concise commit explanation that states why the suppression is necessary and why it is safe.

output_examples.input: Verify that an AI-generated fix is ready.
output_examples.output: The workflow requires actual verification, checks for integrity violations, and blocks claims of completion when checks were not run.

best_practices: Run the manual integrity check before committing or declaring work complete.
Treat blocked patterns as review signals, then fix the underlying issue when possible.
Document necessary suppressions with a clear technical reason in the commit message.
anti_patterns: Installing the hook without reviewing the plugin source and repository policy.
Deleting assertions or tests to make a failing change appear successful.
Claiming completion before running real verification on the final changes.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps block commits that contain integrity risks such as warning suppressions, commented tests, deleted assertions, and empty catch blocks.

faq.question: Does it change my source code?
faq.answer: The skill describes checks and hook setup. The install command may modify Git hook configuration for the repository.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it produce false positives?
faq.answer: Yes. Some suppressions may be legitimate, so the skill asks for a reviewer-ready explanation when one is needed.

faq.question: Does it replace tests or code review?
faq.answer: No. It is a guardrail for risky patterns, not proof that the code is correct or fully tested.

faq.question: Is shell access required?
faq.answer: Yes, the documented install and manual check workflows use bash commands that execute scripts from the plugin root.
